QUOTE: "The library's own allocator uses the same hook. `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init()` (`library/memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-576`) calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()` itself."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init calls the setter, but never says it is the only in-tree user, and the item requires that exclusivity.
